items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 21:1
items.html: (To the question) Before ZON have an existence of their own, namely, in the second pregnancy, ZON cannot rise by their own power, and then it is discerned that the upper one raises them, and this is through the raising of the NHY of AA to his HGT, with which rises the aspect of the MAN of ZA, as is said in Part 10. However, after ZA has already attained his smallness, he rises by himself as MAN, and not by the power of the upper one, and then it is discerned that ZA rises by himself as MAN to Aba and Ima, and raises with him also the NHY of AA. (Item 49).
